# Two Meridian

> Free interactive geography game and country guesser: guess and name all 196 countries on an interactive world map.

Two Meridian is a web-based geography game and country guesser at https://twomeridian.in. Players guess and type country names to fill in an interactive world map. The game includes:

- **Casual Mode**: Untimed world countries guessing of all 196 sovereign nations across 6 continents
- **Speed Run Mode**: Timed country guesser challenges with combo streaks and daily leaderboards
- **Reverse Mode**: Guess the country by its highlighted shape and geographic telemetry clues
- **Capitals Quiz**: Test knowledge of all 196 world capitals
- **Flags Quiz**: Identify all 196 sovereign flags

The game is completely free, ad-free, requires no signup, and works in any modern browser. It features an interactive 3D map, fact cards for every country, and real-time leaderboards.

## Key Facts
- 196 countries (193 UN members plus Kosovo, Taiwan, Vatican City)
- Three game modes (Casual, Speed, Reverse)
- Additional quizzes for capitals and flags
- Daily leaderboards with live rankings
- No ads, no tracking, no account required
